description: IEEJ publishes standard electricity-network models for comparative technical studies. The collection includes 50 Hz loop and 60 Hz longitudinal transmission systems with 10 and 30 machines, plus representative distribution networks and electrical parameters. The provider is Institute of Electrical Engineers of Japan, Power and Energy Society. Coverage: These are Japanese benchmark representations, not current measured networks. The transmission examples were developed in 1997–1999 and the page records a September 2000 correction. Access: The official descriptions and download labels were read. Model archives and executable files were not obtained. Licence and cost: The page does not establish a reuse licence or complete cost conditions. Provider confirmation is required before reuse. Limitations: Model age and solver-specific control representations matter. The page does not establish a modern package licence or compatibility with every current simulator. For simulation they support reproducible comparison of power-flow, stability and distribution-network calculations. Related resources: CPAT is a separate analytical program family. These benchmark definitions do not include a verified CPAT software entitlement.
